offering_description.value: Xtant Medical sells bone graft products and spinal implants to hospitals and surgery centers for orthopedic and spine procedures. It processes donated human tissue into grafts and supplies implant systems through direct sales and independent distributors.

primary_products.value: Demineralized bone grafts; cellular bone allografts; structural bone allografts; synthetic bone graft substitutes; spinal fixation and interbody implants

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers and surgical supply distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bone graft products and spinal implant systems purchased for surgical use

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes donated human tissue into grafts and develops spinal implant systems for surgical facilities and distributors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with some international distribution

specialization.value: related lines: Bone graft products and spinal implant systems for orthopedic and spine procedures

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales representatives serving hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers; distributors / dealers: Independent distributors specializing in orthopedic and spine surgery products

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA rules for human tissue processing and premarket clearance requirements for applicable spinal implants

notes: The current country list and exact spinal implant lineup are uncertain.

P2.3: Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for Biofilm Engineering. We evolved into Xtant Medical, where today, we deliver a comprehensive biologics and fixation portfolio while staying true to our roots: honoring donors, serving patients, and innovating for the future. Our biologics are processed in a dedicated, state-of-the-art facility using patented technologies like BacteRinse™ to preserve essential growth factors while ensuring safety and clinical reliability. This focus allows us to honor every donor gift with the highest standards of quality and respect.
